verdict.rationale: Insomnia is an API client and design/testing tool, not an API gateway, so enforcing authentication on upstream APIs through gateway plugins or policies is outside its product role. The evidence about Insomnia plugins and pre-request auth scripting covers client-side request tooling. The mention of connecting to Konnect for 'protecting requests' describes a separate Kong platform, not a gateway capability that Insomnia ships.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce authentication (API keys, OAuth2, JWT, mTLS) on upstream APIs via gateway plugins or policies
